programmes.d: Irita Marriott falls in love with an early 20th century Islamic bowl, vintage fountain pens and a vintage steamer suitcase, while Ishy Khan takes his chances on a Victorian brooch, an Art Deco coin purse and a gear box from a jet fighter.
James Braxton and Charles Hanson are heading across the Solent to the Isle of Wight in search of bargains, and Charles finds a bit of history.
Experts Mark Stacey and Mark Hales battle it out in the antiques shops of eastern England.

It's the final day of the road trip! Irita Marriott finds a 19th century French mantel clock, a vintage ink standish and a copper jug. Ishy uncovers a Chinese bellows, vintage glass salt dish and an early 20th century inkwell.
James Braxton and Charles Hanson are battling it out along the Dorset and Devon coast--and there's a big surprise at the auction in Torquay.
In the battle of the two Marks, Mark Stacey and Mark Hales make surprising investments.
It's day four and James Braxton and Charles Hanson are heading for Cornwall, where Charles has an enchanting experience and James goes to the fair.
It's day one of the new series! Anita Manning and Mark Stacey start their journey in Aberfeldy and head for auction glory in Dundee.
Mark Stacey visits the Ely Cathedral and Mark Hales gets excited about a sketchbook.
James Braxton and Charles Hanson head deep into Cornwall on the last day of their road trip. James goes to church before the final auction in Truro.
It's still anyone's game, as Anita Manning and Mark Stacey travel from Wiston in South Lanarkshire to Edinburgh.
Mark Stacey and Mark Hales head for East Anglia as the battle intensifies.
It's a new road trip! Anita Manning and Philip Serrell are touring the north of England in their classic car, aiming for a profit in Edinburgh.
Day three of Anita Manning and Mark Stacey's antique hunt takes them from the Scottish borders to Sunderland, with a remarkable find along the way.
Mark Hales gets a lesson in spying and Mark Stacey is left stunned at the auction.
As Anita Manning and Philip Serrell head to auction in County Durham, Philip develops an odd interest in sewing and Anita eyes up a wedding dress.
Day four of Anita Manning and Mark Stacey's journey from St. Helen Auckland to Darlington is derailed when their car breaks down.
Thomas Plant and James Lewis go bargain hunting in the highlands and lowlands of Scotland.
Anita Manning and Philip Serrell get the bit between their teeth as they head through the Dales and make the most of its horse racing history.
Thomas Plant and James Lewis pick up some unusual items as they travel across Scotland.
Anita Manning and Mark Stacey's final leg takes them from Richmond in North Yorkshire to the auction showdown in Huby near York.
On day four of their trip Anita Manning and Philip Serrell head for the bright lights of Blackpool and can't resist a visit to the pleasure beach.
Thomas Plant takes a financial gamble and James Lewis talks to animals.
A new day and a new team: experts Philip Serrell and Catherine Southon start their trip in Aboyne and finish up at an auction in Dundee.
Anita Manning and Philip Serrell go head-to-head at an auction in Harrogate on this final day of their road trip.
There’s more car trouble for experts Thomas Plant and James Lewis.
Day two sees some tactical shenanigans from rivals Philip Serrell and Catherine Southon, as they travel from Perth to Paisley.
Experts Mark Stacey and Mark Hales battle it out in the auction rooms and antiques shops of eastern England in a race to turn an unbeatable profit.
Thomas Plant trades four wheels for two. James Lewis gets to the root of Auld Lang Syne.
In the battle of the two Marks, Mark Stacey and Mark Hales make some surprising investments as they make their way from Rutland to Norfolk.
Philip Serrell and Catherine Southon's affections start to wane as they hit the road for day three, crossing the border from Glenluce to Carlisle.
Charlie Ross and Catherine Southon begin in the heart of Wiltshire and finish in Devizes.
On the third day of their road trip Mark Stacey visits the magnificent Ely Cathedral and his opponent Mark Hales gets excited about a sketchbook.
The competition between Philip Serrell and Catherine Southon intensifies as they journey from Sedburgh to Leeds.
Charlie Ross and Catherine Southon cozy up on their trip across southern England.
Road trippers Mark Stacey and Mark Hales head for East Anglia in their classic car as the battle to win intensifies between them.
Philip Serrell and Catherine Southon head from Skipton to Liverpool for their final auction showdown.
Catherine Southon and Charlie Ross are headed for a shock at the auction in Lewes.
In this final day of their 300-mile road trip, Mark Hales gets a lesson in spying and Mark Stacey is left stunned at the auction.
It's day one for expert Thomas Plant and Road Trip newbie, Scottish auctioneer Paul Laidlaw, as they travel from Skipton to Sheffield.
Charlie Ross and Catherine Southon take in some history on their trip to London.
It's time for Thomas Plant and James Lewis to take their classic car bargain hunting around the highlands and lowlands of Scotland.
It’s the final showdown for Charlie Ross and Catherine Southon: auction in Rye.
Day two for dynamic duo Thomas Plant and Paul Laidlaw sees them attempt to outwit each other on their way from Bolsover to the auction in Stamford.
Experts Thomas Plant and James Lewis pick up some very unusual items as they travel across Scotland from west to east coast in their classic car.
John Simpson finds war items and Martha Kearney finds some objects for auction.
It's charm versus mathematical prowess, as experts Thomas Plant and Paul Laidlaw hit the shops between Huntingdon and Towcester.
Thomas Plant takes a financial gamble and James Lewis talks to animals on the third leg of their trip around Scotland.
There's more car trouble for experts Thomas Plant and James Lewis on the fourth leg of their tour of Scotland.
Thomas Plant and Paul Laidlaw's negotiating tactics are tested to the limit as they travel from Olney to the auction in Watlington.
Olympic athletes Colin Jackson and triple jumper Jonathan Edwards shop for antiques.
In the final leg of their trip Thomas Plant trades four wheels for two and James Lewis gets to the root of popular New Year's anthem Auld Lang Syne.
Thomas Plant and Paul Laidlaw spend their final day of antique adventuring heading from Tetsworth to the final auction showdown in Pewsey.
Presenter Nicholas Parsons and writer/broadcaster Gyles Brandreth travel around Surrey.

Charlie Ross and Catherine Southon to hit the road in their classic car on a 200-mile journey to out-buy each other and outdo each other at auction. They begin in Corsham in the heart of Wiltshire and finish with an auction in Devizes.
It's a Welsh road trip for Kate Bliss and Paul Laidlaw. Some fake currency and a leg of mutton could cause problems for our pair of antiquers at a Somerset auction.
Hilarity ensues when comedy duo Tommy Cannon and Bobby Ball hit the road.
It's day two for Charlie Ross and Catherine Southon as they cosy up on their rain-swept journey criss-crossing southern England in the hunt for antiques to sell at an auction in Wareham, Dorset.
Kate Bliss and Paul Laidlaw forage for antiques across the West Country in a stylish 1960s Volvo. Paul's fortunes rest on a treasure from Africa while Kate blows a very, very big horn.
Day three of their jaunt finds Catherine Southon and Charlie Ross wending their way along the south coast, headed for a shock at the auction in Lewes.
Actors and friends Sunetra Sarker visit shops, and the occasional farm, around Somerset.

Paul Laidlaw resorts to tank warfare to crush Kate Bliss's chances of profit. Kate finds out about a decisive naval confrontation while Paul heads to Southampton to discover how Britain's landscape has been mapped for generations.
As Charlie Ross and Catherine Southon battle it out on day four, they take in some history on their trip from the south coast of England to London.
Fashion guru Gok Wan and actress Harriet Thorpe shop around Sussex.

Paul Laidlaw and Kate Bliss hope to capitalize on some risky buys. Paul believes a strange collection of medals will honor him with profits, but will a pricey three-figure gamble purchase pay off for Kate?
It's the final showdown for Charlie Ross and Catherine Southon as they embark on their last journey in the classic car, heading for auction in Rye.
Two snooker legends swap sports for antiques!
It's the start of a brand-new series as Thomas Plant and Philip Serrell team up for a 700-mile trip beginning in Lancashire and the Isle of Man.

Kate Bliss and Paul Laidlaw's final trip sees them through Kent. At an incredible auction in Bury St. Edmunds, the Antiques Road Trip record profit is truly smashed, and when the gavel finally goes down one expert is left close to tears.
Philip Serrell thinks "big is best" on his shopping trip with rival expert Thomas Plant as they journey from York to Rotherham in search of a bargain.

Christina Trevanion and James Braxton are in the Scottish Borders with a '60s Jaguar. James resorts to a flashlight as he rummages in the dark for an occasional table while Christina hopes some silver-plated cutlery will serve up a profit.
It’s the battle of the IQs as Eggheads Barry Simmons & Lisa Thiel hit the antiques trail!
Thomas Plant gets to ride in a special classic car and Philip Serrell has his eye on a unique lady, as they make their way through the Peak District.

Christina Trevanion and James Braxton's are in the cold and snowy Trossachs. James investigates some ancient treasures in a Glasgow graveyard and farmer's wife Christina learns why it was the Scots who transformed arable farming.
Christine Walkden and Matthew Biggs travel around Befordshire and Northamptonshire.
On the fourth leg of their road trip, Thomas Plant has a brush with showbiz and Philip Serrell takes a fancy to some gym equipment.

Christina Trevanion and James Braxton start in Levenshulme, Manchester. James has the unusual problem of having too much cash, while Christina struggles with her limited funds, deciding to gamble them on a worn toy train.
Scientists Dr. Maggie Aderin-Pocock and Miranda Krestovnikoff join the Road Trip.
